mechanism: Scopolamine's anticholinergic effects may reduce salivary flow and increase oral dryness, while lisinopril commonly causes dry cough and hyperkalemia; combined anticholinergic activity may potentiate urinary retention and increase cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and potassium levels; counsel patient on increased dry mouth risk and watch for urinary retention or cardiovascular changes; use scopolamine cautiously in patients on ACE inhibitors.
